description: Mailing-list search, BM25 over own words and semantic, blended per thread; every list unless inbox narrows it. Up to limit threads, best first, each its best message: inbox, message_id, subject, from, date, thread_id, fused_score (0-1), similarity, excerpt. author/since/until: one sender in a date window. Takes search operators (operators, warnings, skipped report them); complete=false when out of budget_ms. A commit SHA returns the mail referring to it (how_it_refers).

inbox.description: all (default), a list, or several comma-separated

query.description: Words or a question; search's operators

since.description: On or after: YYYY[-MM[-DD]], ISO, or 2w/6m/1y ago

name: hybrid_search
